_note: Photos for the 'Para sa bawat okasyon' gallery on the home page, in display order. Files live in src/assets/images/. Cooked lechon only — no raw-meat or prep shots. 'occasion' is the tag shown on the photo (one of: Piyesta, Bagong Taon at Pasko, Birthday, Reunion, Salo-salo — the pool in Occasions.astro), or null for no tag. The tags were assigned for marketing at the owner's direction (2026-09-28); replace any with the real event once known. Layout repeats every four photos — a large tile, a tall tile, two small — so landscape shots suit positions 1, 5, 9…, portrait shots positions 2, 6, 10…

items.alt: A whole lechon, roasted a deep glossy mahogany, laid on foil on a wooden table as hands ready it for the table.
Lechon belly in a foil-lined box, its skin blistered into crisp golden bubbles.
A whole lechon turning on a spit over glowing coals in a block-walled pit, smoke rising behind it.
Four white trays filled with dinuguan, ready to go out with an order.
Close-up of a lechon belly roll on banana leaf, its crackling glazed deep red-gold.
Two of the Alzar's family wrapping a whole lechon in yellow paper and cardboard for delivery.
A whole lechon on its spit at an evening celebration, skin shining under the lights.
